title: automate-kms-hsm-tls-rotation-private-installer-helm-terraform
author: Ava Chen
description: Automates TLS certificate and key rotation for Private Installer deployments and the associated Helm + Terraform modules. This change adds a rotation orchestration flow that supports both cloud KMS and on-prem HSM-backed keys, integrates Vault and SealedSecrets for secret staging, and provides safe upgrade/rollback hooks for in-place installer upgrades. Motivation: customers running Private need automated, auditable cert/key rotation that works for VPC/on-prem topologies and HSM-backed key material, and that can be integrated into existing install/upgrade pipelines. What changed: (1) Terraform: new kms/hsm module outputs and lifecycle resources to register rotation schedules and grant Vault access; (2) Helm: chart templates for a cert-rotation Kubernetes Job, leader-election, and a pre-upgrade hook job; (3) Installer: orchestration logic to coordinate rotation across control-plane components with a safe canary-first rollout and automatic fallback; (4) Secrets: optional Vault integration for dynamic credentials, and SealedSecrets controller support for bootstrap targets; (5) Scripts: idempotent rotate-certs.sh used by both CI and operator; (6) Tests: e2e and upgrade tests validating no-downtime rotation and HSM/GCP KMS flows. Rollback strategy and SLOs are documented in the deployment notes. This is intended to be backwards compatible when integrations are not enabled; toggles are provided for customers who want manual rotation only.

release_notes: - Automation: added TLS/key rotation orchestration for Private Installer supporting cloud KMS and on-prem HSM. - Helm: cert-rotation job and pre-upgrade hook to enable zero-downtime rotation. - Terraform: kms/hsm module outputs and example configs for rotation schedules and Vault integration. - Secrets: optional Vault dynamic secrets and SealedSecrets bootstrap support. - Docs: operator guide for rotation, rollback strategy, and troubleshooting.
notes: Operators should read docs/operations/cert-rotation.md before enabling HSM/KMS auto-rotation. For HSM deployments ensure vendor agent is available on host nodes and that the terraform HSM module has been initialized with the correct provider credentials.
